name: Stress
author: Alexandria
summary: Horror and hardship build stress; at the limit a character breaks with a flaw for the session.

rules.text: Terrifying sights, failed saves against fear and grim losses add **stress**. A long rest takes 2 away. At the limit the character **breaks**: they gain a short-term madness or a flaw for the rest of the session, then drop to half the limit.

assistant.dm: Stress is on: add 1 for terrifying sights, failed fear saves and grim losses (2 for the truly awful). At the limit the character breaks: give a short-term madness or flaw for the session, then set stress to half. A long rest removes 2.
assistant.player: Stress builds from horror and hardship and a long rest takes 2 off. At the limit your character breaks for the session, so rest and find comfort when you can.
